ordersText.title: A SINGLE THRUST
ordersText.general: If this advance order results in a combat, you may play an additional combat card during the first round. *newline* However, after each round of combat your combat cards are discarded and do not carry over to future rounds. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: CROWN JEWEL
ordersText.general: After you take control of a city as a result of this order resolution, you may immediately claim an Objective token from any world under the control of the previous owner of that city. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER GAME.

ordersText.title: SHEER PERFECTION
ordersText.general: Your combat deck can consist of 8-14 cards. If there are 10 or more cards in your combat deck when you purchase combat upgrades, you may discard additional pairs of combat cards from your deck.

ordersText.title: SONIC AMPLIFIERS
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. *newline*  During this orbital strike you may spend 2 [B] to destroy a structure on the target world. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: UNBRIDLED HEDONISM
ordersText.general: While resolving this order, there is no limit on the number of upgrades you may purchase of each type. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: A FEAST TO REMEMBER
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this scheme after collecting materiel in the Refresh phase. Either collect materiel once more from all friendly worlds in a single system or gain materiel once more for the Pleasure Seekers on your faction board.

eventsText.title: BEGUILEMENT
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this card at the start of an opponent's turn. That opponent must choose one of their order tokens on the game board and move it to the bottom of its respective stack. Then he skips his turn.

eventsText.title: SHE IS NEVER SATED
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* You must discard this scheme after resolving your next advance order. Immediately resolve this advance order again.

eventsText.title: THE DARK PRINCE BECKONS
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this scheme at the start of a combat on a world. Replace 1 of your opponent's CL0 units with a Pleasure Seeker from your supply.

eventsText.title: DANCE OF THE DEMONETTES
eventsText.general: *newpara* Either place 1 Pleasure Seeker from your supply on your faction board or return any number of Pleasure Seekers from your faction board and place them on any friendly worlds.

eventsText.title: SHE GROWS BORED OF THE GAME
eventsText.general: *newpara* Each opponent may decide, in secret, to claim any one of their unclaimed objectives. If any opponent claims an objective, you may claim one of your unclaimed objectives.

eventsText.title: PRIDE BEFORE THE FALL
eventsText.general: *newpara* Force a player with the most claimed objectives (in case of a tie, you choose) to retun one of his claimed objectives to any enemy or uncontrolled world.

eventsText.title: YOUNGEST AMONG THE GODS
eventsText.general: *newpara* Immediately place 1 order token in any legal system following the usual order token placement rules.

combatText.title: SENSUAL ALLURE
combatText.general: Your opponent must choose and rout 1 of his units.
combatText.unit: Seeker/Cruiser: Gain a number of [S] or [M] equal to the highest CL among unrouted enemy units.

combatText.title: BEWITCH
combatText.general: Force your opponent to lose one of his [D], then gain the same [D].
combatText.unit: Seeker/Cruiser: Discard a card at random from your opponent's hand and resolve its general abilities as if you played it.

combatText.title: IRRESISTIBLE TEMPTATION
combatText.general: Gain 1 (B) for each enemy command level 0 unit.
combatText.unit: Seeker: Replace 1 enemy CL0 unit with an unrouted friendly Pleasure Seeker.

combatText.title: MURDEROUS PASSION
combatText.general: Gain 1 [M]. Gain 1 (B) for every [M] you have.
combatText.unit: Seeker/Cruiser: If a friendly unit is destroyed during this execution round, gain 1 reinforcement token.

combatText.title: BLISSFUL AGONY
combatText.general: Gain 1 (B) or 1 (S). *newpara* If you lose this combat, place 1 order token from your play area on top of your Event deck.
combatText.unit: Noise Marine: The first time a friendly Pleasure Seeker is destroyed during this round of combat, place it on your faction mat. You cannot place reinforcement tokens on your faction mat this way.

combatText.title: UNEXPECTED ALACRITY
combatText.unit: Noise Marine/Cruiser: If your opponent has a routed unit, he destroys all of his routed units. Otherwise, he chooses and routs 1 of his units.

combatText.title: CORRUPTING INFLUENCE
combatText.unit: Noise Marine/Cruiser: Force your opponent to lose 1 [S]. *newpara* Your opponent must choose and give you a card from his hand. Play it. You may resolve its general abilities. If it provides no shield icons, your opponent must discard 1 card from his hand at random.

combatText.title: ACOUSTIC BARRAGE
combatText.general: If your opponent has 1 or more materiel, gain 4 (B) or 4 (S), unless your opponent spends 1 materiel. If he did, gain 1 materiel.
combatText.unit: Noise Marine/Cruiser: Rout a friendly Noise Marine to gain 2 (S).

combatText.title: SHRIEKING HAVOCS
combatText.general: Your opponent chooses for you to gain either 2 (B) or 2 (S). *newpara* If you lose this combat, gain 1 asset of your choice.
combatText.unit: Noise Marine/Cruiser: If you gained 2 (B), remove 1 Pleasure Seeker from your faction board to gain 3 (S).

combatText.title: UNSPEAKABLE PERVERSION
combatText.general: Your opponent may rout any of his units. Gain (S) equal to the number of unrouted enemy units.
combatText.unit: Seeker: Your opponent destroys all reinforcement tokens in this area. Place that many free reinforcement tokens in this area.

combatText.title: MUTUAL DESTRUCTION
combatText.general: Gain (B) equal to the highest command level among unrouted friendly units.
combatText.unit: Defiler/Cruiser/Grand Cruiser: Your opponent may spend any of his [B] and (B). Whenever a friendly unit is destroyed during this combat round, your opponent must destroy his unit of the highest command level.

combatText.title: REVEL IN MISERY
combatText.general: Rally all friendly and enemy units. *newpara* If you are defending, your opponent must choose and destroy his structure on any world.
combatText.unit: Defiler/Cruiser/Grand Cruiser: Gain 2 (B) or 2 (S) for each enemy unit that was rallied as a result of the general ability of this card.

combatText.title: FULGRIM'S AVARICE
combatText.unit: Subjugator Titan/Grand Cruiser: If your opponent has no fewer claimed Objectives than you, replace 1 of his units with an unrouted friendly unit of the same CL from your supply, unless you opponent returns 1 of his claimed Objectives to any enemy or uncontrolled world of his choice.

combatText.title: SONG OF SLAANESH
combatText.general: Place up to 2 Pleasure Seekers from your facion board in this area.
combatText.unit: Subjugator Titan/Grand Cruiser: Gain 1 (S) for every Pleasure Seeker on your faction board.
